steps.instruction: Read the exact request and declared files. Freeze applied commit, route, served-head evidence, presentation ownership, surface class, selected primary surfaces and every required matrix entry. Do not silently defer a journey-required state.

calls.purpose: Read the frozen scope and only bound authority.
Verify served-head ancestry for the applied commit.

produces: Frozen audit matrix and rule inventory.

steps.instruction: Open the exact attested endpoint in a dedicated browser context, sign in by credential name when guarded, and wait for the requested state and representative data. Capture nothing until credential fields are absent and the state is ready.

calls.purpose: Reach the selected rendered state in an isolated browser context.

steps.instruction: Execute the written walk for every matrix entry. Persist the actual screenshot and browser-produced DOM or computed-style measurements for every claim-bearing node. A capture without its walk result and measurements is incomplete.

reads.when: when a written walk is supplied

calls.purpose: Drive, capture and measure each selected matrix entry.

steps.instruction: Inspect screenshots and measurement records together. Judge every claimed rule by its node owner, close the eight proof topics independently, and score taste over the frozen scope using the complete calibration anchors. Record concrete defects for recapture or reassessment.

calls.purpose: Inspect actual screenshots at useful detail.
Persist topic verdicts and audit report.

produces: Concrete failed-criterion feedback or passing review results.

steps.instruction: Write the response with actual paths and hashes, observations and evidence-backed review results. Validate it and present the worst relevant capture beside the verdict. Do not claim full-state coverage from a primary-surface audit.
